theorem lg_target {α : Type u_5} [NonUnitalNonAssocCommSemiring α] (a : α) : a ∈ NonUnitalSubsemiring.center α ↔ ∀ (b : α), Commute (AddMonoid.End.mulLeft b) (AddMonoid.End.mulLeft a) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    intro b
    rw [Commute.def]
    rw [mul_left_comm]
    exact h
  · intro h
    intro b
    rw [Commute.def]
    rw [mul_left_comm]
    exact h
